args.notes: Spec: 32 simultaneous requests per 1us tick, all results back within 0.44us p99. Throughput >= 32 Msps, max_abs_err <= 2^-12. Minimize luts+ffs. Consider pipelined families with enough parallelism (m) to serve 32 requests in 0.44us; iterative likely too slow unless pipelined.
